recentPosts.excerpt: My 100k @Topstep Eval so far: Green day. Red day...
Market opens and I gift myself another red day. Hit DLL...
I've said 'this time is different' so many times it stopped meaning anything...
Passing an eval isn't the hard part for me. The hard part is not sabotaging it...
Knowing the rule was never the problem... the ten seconds after you already knew better.

drafts.text:
The plan always gets written by the calm version of me.
Nothing on the line. All patience. Thinks clearly.
That guy is never in the room when price rips against my stop.
The one who shows up then just wants to be right.
Trading is learning to obey the calm one after he's already left.
drafts.why: Universal split every trader feels, citable last line, no question = repost bait. First person makes it ours.
drafts.why_es: División universal que todo trader siente, última línea citable, sin pregunta = carnada de repost. La primera persona la hace tuya.

drafts.text:
Easiest thing in the world is to feel bad about a red day and scroll past it.
Hardest thing is to line your losses up next to each other and actually look.
They're never random. Same setup. Same time of day. Same feeling in your chest right before you click.
The shame isn't protecting you. It's protecting the pattern.
drafts.why: Turns a common comment into a sharp reframe, universal so no fabricated numbers needed.
drafts.why_es: Convierte un comentario común en un reframe filoso, universal así que no hace falta inventar números.

drafts.text:
Honest question for the prop firm crowd.
What's the real gap between passing an eval and staying passed?
For me it was never the strategy. It was the ten seconds after a clean trend when I decide I suddenly know better.
drafts.why: Direct question = reply engine, ties to his real posted theme, invites the exact audience he wants.
drafts.why_es: Pregunta directa = motor de respuestas, se ancla a tu tema real ya publicado, invita justo al público que quieres.

plan: Lead with Draft 1 (aphorism) for reach. Post Draft 3 a day later for conversation. Hold Draft 2 as the mid-week reframe. Space them out, never stack two in one window.
plan_es: Empieza con el Draft 1 (aforismo) para alcance. Publica el Draft 3 un día después para conversación. Guarda el Draft 2 como reframe de media semana. Espácialos, nunca apiles dos en la misma ventana.

read.working: Concrete + numbers + a twist still wins reach (the Green/Red eval post hit 6.8K). Aphorisms pull fewer views but the highest-quality replies.
read.working_es: Concreto + números + un giro sigue ganando alcance (el post del eval Green/Red llegó a 6.8K). Los aforismos jalan menos vistas pero los comentarios de más calidad.
read.stop: Stacking two low-variety truth-bombs hours apart. Both underperformed (777 and 382). Space formats out.
read.stop_es: Apilar dos truth-bombs de poca variedad con horas de diferencia. Los dos rindieron poco (777 y 382). Espacia los formatos.
read.watch: The '10-second window' idea. Two different people named it in comments today. It's a full post: what drives that window (need to be right vs escape vs ego).
read.watch_es: La idea de 'los diez segundos'. Dos personas distintas la nombraron en comentarios hoy. Da para un post entero: qué te empuja en esa ventana (querer tener razón vs escapar vs ego).

prediction.claim_es: El Draft 1 (aforismo) supera la mediana reciente de ~1.5K vistas dentro de 48h de publicado.
